"""Owned bounded package acceptance; reuse the canonical isolation helpers."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

repo = Path.cwd()
script_folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
folder = Path(os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_EVIDENCE_DIR", str(script_folder))).resolve()
folder.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
sys.path.insert(0, str(repo / "tools"))
from run_tests_isolated import isolated_environment, resolve_real_state_home, snapshot_state

memory = next(int(x.split()[1]) for x in Path("/proc/meminfo").read_text().splitlines() if x.startswith("MemAvailable:"))
assert memory >= 1048576, "Small-package smoke requires 512MiB budget plus512MiB reserve; full-suite3GiB guard is unchanged"
assert not subprocess.check_output(["git", "status", "--porcelain"], text=True)
build = json.loads((folder / "verification-wheel-result.json").read_text())
commit = subprocess.check_output(["git", "rev-parse", "HEAD"], text=True).strip()
assert commit == build["sourceCommit"]
wheel = repo / build["wheel"]
assert hashlib.sha256(wheel.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == build["sha256"]
real_root, real_source = resolve_real_state_home(os.environ)
before = snapshot_state(real_root)
report = {"sourceCommit": commit, "wheelSha256": build["sha256"], "preflightMemoryKiB": memory, "memoryBudgetMiB":512, "reserveMiB":512, "fullSuiteMemoryGuardUnchanged":True, "steps":[], "hostActivated":False}
started = time.monotonic()

def stage(name, argv, env, cwd, timeout=120):
    log = folder / ("installed-" + name + ".log")
    print(json.dumps({"step":name,"state":"running"}), flush=True)
    with log.open("w") as stream:
        child = subprocess.Popen(argv, env=env, cwd=cwd, stdout=stream, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
        try:
            code = child.wait(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
            os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
            try:
                child.wait(timeout=5)
            except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                os.killpg(child.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                child.wait()
            raise
    report["steps"].append({"name":name,"exitCode":code,"log":str(log.relative_to(repo))})
    print(json.dumps(report["steps"][-1]), flush=True)
    assert code == 0, f"{name} failed; preserved log {log}"

try:
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="wheel-smoke-", dir=folder) as temporary:
        work = Path(temporary)
        env = isolated_environment(work / "profile", os.environ)
        env.pop("PYTHONPATH", None)
        env.update(LIBGL_ALWAYS_SOFTWARE="1", OMP_NUM_THREADS="1", OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS="1", LP_NUM_THREADS="1", PYTHONUNBUFFERED="1")
        venv = work / "venv"
        stage("venv", [str(repo / ".venv/bin/python"), "-m", "venv", str(venv)], env, work)
        python = str(venv / "bin/python")
        stage("tls", [python,"-I","-c","import ssl,sqlite3; c=ssl.create_default_context(); assert c.verify_mode==ssl.CERT_REQUIRED and c.check_hostname and c.cert_store_stats()['x509_ca']>0; print(ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION, sqlite3.sqlite_version)"], env, work)
        pip = [python,"-m","pip","--isolated","--disable-pip-version-check","--no-input","--timeout=15","--retries=1"]
        stage("runtime", pip+["install","--only-binary=:all:","--require-hashes","--cache-dir",str(repo/".steamzero-dev/cache/pip"),"-r",str(repo/"requirements-runtime.lock")], env, work)
        stage("wheel", pip+["install","--no-index","--no-deps",str(wheel)], env, work)
        stage("pip-check", pip+["check"], env, work)
        stage("version", [str(venv/"bin/steamzero"),"--version"], env, work)
        stage("doctor", [str(venv/"bin/steamzero"),"doctor","--json"], env, work)
        stage("ports", [python,"-I","-c","from steamzero import ports; assert ports.DevicePort; print('installed ports import OK')"], env, work)
        stage("native-qt", ["xvfb-run","-a","-s","-screen 0 1920x1080x24 -nolisten tcp",python,"-I",str(script_folder/"installed_native_acceptance.py"),"--repo",str(repo),"--commit",commit], env, work, timeout=480)
    report["temporaryEnvironmentRemoved"] = True
finally:
    after = snapshot_state(real_root)
    report["realStateUnchanged"] = before == after
    report["realStateSource"] = real_source
    report["seconds"] = time.monotonic()-started
    (folder/"noneditable-smoke-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
    print(json.dumps(report), flush=True)
    assert before == after, "Real state changed; inspect without overwriting operator data"

"""Reuse existing Qt journeys against a non-editable installed package only."""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--repo", type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument("--commit", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
repo = args.repo.resolve()
script_folder = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
output = Path(os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_EVIDENCE_DIR", str(script_folder))).resolve()
output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

# Resolve the application before making development-only helpers available.
import steamzero
from steamzero import _build_info

package = Path(steamzero.__file__).resolve().parent
assert package.is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve()), package
assert not package.is_relative_to(repo / "src"), package
assert _build_info.SOURCE_COMMIT == args.commit
assert _build_info.SOURCE_DIRTY is False
direct = json.loads(importlib.metadata.distribution("steamzero").read_text("direct_url.json"))
assert not direct.get("dir_info", {}).get("editable", False)

manifest_path = Path(os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_SOURCE_MANIFEST", str(script_folder / "tested-files-r3.json")))
manifest = json.loads(manifest_path.read_text())
verified_resources = 0
for name, expected in manifest["files"].items():
    if name.startswith("src/steamzero/"):
        target = package / name.removeprefix("src/steamzero/")
        assert target.is_file(), name
        assert hashlib.sha256(target.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == expected, name
        verified_resources += 1

# These helpers drive the actual installed HTTP bridge and QML controls.
# Adding these paths does not execute editable-install .pth files.
dev_site = repo / ".venv/lib" / f"python{sys.version_info.major}.{sys.version_info.minor}" / "site-packages"
assert dev_site.is_dir()
sys.path.extend([str(dev_site), str(repo)])
import pytest
from tests.integration import test_native_wheel as journey

captures = output / "installed-captures"
captures.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
os.environ["SZ_CAPTURE_DIR"] = str(captures)
results = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="installed-native-", dir=output) as temporary:
    qa_root = Path(temporary) / "harnesses"
    qml = qa_root / "tests/qml"
    qml.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name in ("check_native_wheel_authoring.qml", "check_native_wheel_runtime.qml"):
        original = (repo / "tests/qml" / name).read_text()
        copied = original.replace("../../src/steamzero/ui/qml", (package / "ui/qml").as_uri())
        assert copied != original
        (qml / name).write_text(copied)
    journey.ROOT = qa_root
    only_recovery_ui = os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_ONLY_RECOVERY_UI") == "1"
    for compact in (() if only_recovery_ui else (False, True)):
        profile = Path(temporary) / ("compact" if compact else "wide")
        profile.mkdir()
        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
            journey.test_wheel_authoring_controls_use_real_bridge_and_persist(profile, patch, compact)
        results.append({"compactAuthoring": compact, "passed": True})
        print(json.dumps(results[-1]), flush=True)

    if os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_CONSUMER_INTEGRITY") == "1":
        from tests.integration import test_theme_catalog_routes as recovery
        cases = [
            ("active-preference", recovery.test_removal_refuses_active_preference_and_recovers_after_switch, False, None),
            ("stale-activation", recovery.test_activation_plan_refuses_a_theme_removed_after_preview, False, None),
            ("preference-rollback-reimport", recovery.test_preference_rollback_refuses_missing_theme_and_recovers_after_reimport, True, None),
            ("gc-rollback-with-compatibility", recovery.test_gc_preserves_assets_owned_by_a_live_theme_rollback, True, True),
            ("gc-rollback-core-only", recovery.test_gc_preserves_assets_owned_by_a_live_theme_rollback, True, False),
        ]
        cases.extend(("http-journey-" + kind, recovery.test_http_removal_preserves_journey_consumers_and_recovers_after_release, True, kind)
                     for kind in ("saved", "draft", "history", "bezel"))
        for name, run, with_path, kind in ([] if only_recovery_ui else cases):
            profile = Path(temporary) / name
            profile.mkdir()
            with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
                dashboard = recovery.dashboard.__wrapped__(profile, patch)
                try:
                    call = [dashboard]
                    if with_path: call.append(profile)
                    if kind is not None: call.append(kind)
                    run(*call)
                finally:
                    dashboard.close_request_context()
            results.append({"installedRecovery": name, "passed": True})
            print(json.dumps(results[-1]), flush=True)

        if os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_ROLLBACK_PROVENANCE") == "1":
            from tests.integration import test_operation_history as history_cases
            from tests.integration import test_frontend_adapters as frontend_cases
            from tests.unit import test_theme_acquire as acquire_cases
            from steamzero.core import paths
            from steamzero.domain.theme_assets import ThemeAssetStore

            provenance_cases = []
            for stage in ("apply.backup", "apply.verify", "apply.after-commit"):
                provenance_cases.append(("interrupted-" + stage, "dashboard", recovery.test_interrupted_theme_publication_recovers_from_the_core_backup, [stage], False))
            for damage in ("bytes", "symlink", "directory", "journal", "empty-journal", "journal-header", "journal-identity", "journal-kind"):
                provenance_cases.append(("damaged-" + damage, "dashboard", recovery.test_damaged_core_recovery_refuses_collection_and_restoration_then_recovers, [damage], True))
            for name, fn in (("history-theme-context", history_cases.test_theme_acquisition_requires_the_catalogs_contextual_rollback), ("history-pending-preference", history_cases.test_theme_preference_and_pending_legacy_history_plan_require_theme_context)):
                provenance_cases.append((name, "history", fn, [], False))
            for name, fn in (("legacy-snapshot-preserved", acquire_cases.test_unproven_legacy_snapshot_is_preserved_without_replacing_the_current_theme), ("missing-old-asset", acquire_cases.test_rollback_refuses_missing_old_asset_and_recovers_after_reingestion), ("rollback-idempotent", acquire_cases.test_repeated_replacement_rollback_preserves_the_restored_theme_and_result), ("superseded-install", acquire_cases.test_install_rollback_refuses_a_version_superseded_by_another_install)):
                provenance_cases.append((name, "acquisition", fn, [], True))
            provenance_cases.append(("frontend-large-beforeimage", "frontend", frontend_cases.test_esde_rollback_accepts_a_large_valid_foreign_section_preserved_by_the_adapter, [], False))
            for target in ("srm", "esde"):
                for kind in ("emulator.config", "theme.acquire"):
                    provenance_cases.append(("frontend-foreign-" + target + "-" + kind, "frontend", frontend_cases.test_frontend_rollback_refuses_a_foreign_operation_without_changing_its_files, [target, kind], False))
                provenance_cases.append(("frontend-other-" + target, "frontend", frontend_cases.test_frontend_rollback_refuses_the_other_frontends_operation, [target], False))
                provenance_cases.append(("frontend-root-" + target, "frontend", frontend_cases.test_frontend_rollback_refuses_its_kind_at_an_unrelated_root, [target], False))
            provenance_cases.append(("frontend-positive-cli", "frontend", frontend_cases.test_frontends_plan_then_apply_then_verify_then_rollback, [], False))
            for failure in ("compatibility-copy", "state-recorder"):
                provenance_cases.append(("publication-fault-" + failure, "acquisition-patch", acquire_cases.test_failed_recovery_mirror_restores_the_previous_theme_and_allows_retry, [failure], True))
            provenance_cases.append(("publication-concurrent-write", "acquisition-patch", acquire_cases.test_stale_install_preview_preserves_the_concurrent_write_and_can_be_replanned, [], True))
            for damage in ("symlink", "directory"):
                provenance_cases.append(("current-manifest-" + damage, "acquisition", acquire_cases.test_unsafe_current_manifest_refuses_rollback_until_the_owned_file_is_repaired, [damage], True))
            provenance_cases.append(("opaque-owned-beforeimage", "acquisition", acquire_cases.test_hash_owned_opaque_beforeimage_is_restored_byte_exactly, [], True))
            for budget, remaining in (("MAX_THEME_JOURNAL_BYTES", 64), ("MAX_THEME_JOURNAL_RECORDS", 1), ("MAX_THEME_JOURNAL_SCAN_ENTRIES", 1), ("MAX_THEME_JOURNAL_SCAN_BYTES", 1), ("MAX_ROLLBACK_MANIFEST_BYTES", 1), ("MAX_ROLLBACK_MANIFESTS", 0), ("MAX_ROLLBACK_TOTAL_BYTES", 1)):
                provenance_cases.append(("budget-" + budget.lower(), "dashboard-patch", recovery.test_exhausted_core_recovery_budget_preserves_data_and_releases_gc_after_retry, [budget, remaining], False))
            provenance_cases.append(("shared-core-journal", "dashboard", recovery.test_gc_shares_the_core_journal_without_claiming_other_domains_or_reopening_undo, [], True))
            for action in ("install", "uninstall", "rollback"):
                provenance_cases.append(("directory-alias-" + action, "acquisition-no-path", acquire_cases.test_theme_directory_alias_cannot_change_another_theme_or_bypass_its_consumer, [action], False))
            provenance_cases.append(("http-active-directory-alias", "dashboard", recovery.test_http_directory_alias_preserves_the_active_theme_then_allows_explicit_recovery, [], True))
            if os.environ.get("SZ_PACKAGE_CANONICAL_ASSIGNMENT") == "1":
                from tests.unit import test_media_sources as media_cases

                provenance_cases.extend([
                    ("canonical-library-assignment", "dashboard", recovery.test_studio_assigns_one_master_to_canonical_games_and_history_can_restore, [], True),
                    ("canonical-steam-only", "dashboard-patch", recovery.test_steam_only_library_uses_the_assigned_cover_in_both_consumers, [], True),
                    ("canonical-existing-metadata", "media-registry", media_cases.test_preserved_master_assignment_keeps_the_existing_game_identity_and_rolls_back, [], True),
                    ("canonical-conflict-and-master-repair", "media-registry", media_cases.test_source_assignment_preserves_a_newer_publication_and_recovers_missing_master, [], True),
                ])
            for name, fixture, run, extra, with_path in provenance_cases:
                profile = Path(temporary) / ("provenance-" + name)
                profile.mkdir()
                with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
                    dashboard = None
                    if fixture == "history":
                        patch.setenv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME", str(profile / "config"))
                        patch.setenv("XDG_CACHE_HOME", str(profile / "cache"))
                    else:
                        dashboard = recovery.dashboard.__wrapped__(profile, patch)
                    try:
                        if fixture == "dashboard":
                            call = [dashboard] + ([profile] if with_path else []) + extra
                        elif fixture == "dashboard-patch":
                            call = [dashboard] + ([profile] if with_path else []) + [patch] + extra
                        elif fixture == "acquisition-patch":
                            call = [ThemeAssetStore(paths.theme_assets_dir()), paths.themes_dir(), profile, patch] + extra
                        elif fixture == "acquisition-no-path":
                            call = [ThemeAssetStore(paths.theme_assets_dir()), paths.themes_dir()] + extra
                        elif fixture == "media-registry":
                            call = [profile]
                        elif fixture == "history":
                            call = [history_cases.history_home.__wrapped__(profile, patch)]
                        elif fixture == "frontend":
                            call = [frontend_cases.isolated.__wrapped__(patch, profile)] + extra
                        else:
                            call = [ThemeAssetStore(paths.theme_assets_dir()), paths.themes_dir(), profile] + extra
                        if fixture == "frontend":
                            import contextlib, io, types
                            captured = io.StringIO()
                            class CliOutput:
                                def readouterr(self):
                                    value = captured.getvalue()
                                    captured.seek(0)
                                    captured.truncate(0)
                                    return types.SimpleNamespace(out=value, err="")
                            with contextlib.redirect_stdout(captured):
                                run(CliOutput(), *call)
                        else:
                            run(*call)
                    finally:
                        if dashboard is not None:
                            dashboard.close_request_context()
                results.append({"installedProvenance": name, "passed": True})
                print(json.dumps(results[-1]), flush=True)

        # Same installed panel and existing real HTTP bridge, actual confirmation
        # clicks and disk/readback. No replacement implementation of import.
        exec((script_folder / "installed_package_recovery_ui.py").read_text(), globals())

    from tests.integration import test_theme_scene_runtime_e2e as runtime_scene

    runtime_profile = Path(temporary) / "retrofe-entry"
    runtime_profile.mkdir()
    runtime_harness = qml / runtime_scene.HARNESS.name
    capture_anchor = '            verify(find(preview, "notDrawnLine").text.indexOf("1") !== -1)'
    source = runtime_scene.HARNESS.read_text()
    assert source.count(capture_anchor) == 1
    captured_image = captures / "retrofe-entry-studio.png"
    capture_path = json.dumps(str(captured_image))
    runtime_harness.write_text(
        source.replace("../../src/steamzero/ui/qml", (package / "ui/qml").as_uri())
            .replace(capture_anchor, capture_anchor
                + f"\n            grabImage(preview.parent).save({capture_path})"),
        encoding="utf-8",
    )
    with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
        patch.setattr(runtime_scene, "HARNESS", runtime_harness)
        runtime_scene.test_qml_desenha_pixels_das_cenas_esde_e_retrofe(runtime_profile, patch)
    with captured_image.open("rb") as capture:
        assert capture.read(8) == b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n"
    results.append({"installedRetrofeStudioEntry": True, "passed": True})
    print(json.dumps(results[-1]), flush=True)

loaded = []
for name, module in list(sys.modules.items()):
    if name == "steamzero" or name.startswith("steamzero."):
        location = getattr(module, "__file__", None)
        if location:
            assert Path(location).resolve().is_relative_to(package), (name, location)
            loaded.append(name)
receipt = {
    "commit": args.commit,
    "nonEditable": True,
    "verifiedInstalledResources": verified_resources,
    "applicationModulesFromInstalledPackage": len(loaded),
    "journeys": results,
    "helpers": "Existing development pytest and unit/integration fixture helpers drive installed application modules. Qt controls use the real HTTP bridge and importer; only harness import URI/config location is redirected. Recovery tests explicitly include controlled I/O callbacks, race/budget/journal faults and real owned-child SIGKILL. These prove observed installed-code recovery, not real hardware failure or an external download journey. All application modules and QML resources come from the installed wheel.",
    "level": "Installed non-editable package, isolated synthetic profiles and controlled fault injection, Qt software authoring and RHI Launcher; no host activation, personal-profile migration, full catalog-download UI or physical hardware acceptance.",
    "temporaryProfileRemoved": True,
}
(output / "installed-native-result.json").write_text(json.dumps(receipt, indent=2) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(receipt), flush=True)

"""Additional installed acceptance driven by the existing bridge/Qt harness."""
import queue
import subprocess
import threading

from tests.integration.test_desktop_ui_bridge import Context
from tests.integration.test_ui_shell_retrofe_import_late_response import RUNNER
from steamzero.adapters.desktop_ui import DesktopControlServer
from steamzero.core import paths
from steamzero.core.state import StateStore
from steamzero.domain.desktop import ExperienceCoordinator
from steamzero.core.errors import SteamZeroError

assert RUNNER is not None
prefix = (repo / "tests/qml/check_native_wheel_authoring.qml").read_text().split(
    "        function test_native_creation_from_canonical_master() {", 1
)[0]
assert "test_native_creation_from_canonical_master" not in prefix
prefix = prefix.replace("../../src/steamzero/ui/qml", (package / "ui/qml").as_uri())
prefix = prefix.replace("import QtQuick\n", "import QtQuick\nimport QtQuick.Window\n", 1)
prefix = prefix.replace('name: "NativeWheelAuthoring"', 'name: "InstalledPackageRecovery"')
body = r'''
        function matching(item, predicate) {
            if (predicate(item)) return item
            const children = item.children || []
            for (const child of children) {
                const hit = matching(child, predicate)
                if (hit) return hit
            }
            return null
        }
        function test_installed_recovery_with_confirmation_and_readback() {
            const r = new XMLHttpRequest()
            r.open("GET", Qt.resolvedUrl("../../build/ui-native-wheel-authoring.json"), false)
            r.send()
            harness.cfg = JSON.parse(r.responseText)
            harness.width = cfg.viewportWidth
            harness.height = cfg.viewportHeight
            wait(200)
            const trigger = findChild(panel, "themeImportPackageButton")
            verify(trigger !== null && trigger.visible && trigger.enabled)
            mouseClick(trigger)
            const dialog = findChild(panel, "themeImportPackageDialog")
            tryVerify(function() { return dialog.opened }, 3000)
            const source = matching(dialog.contentItem, function(item) {
                return item.placeholderText === "Arquivo .zip do tema"
            })
            verify(source !== null)
            console.log("RECOVERY-FIELD " + JSON.stringify({width: source.width,
                height: source.height, visible: source.visible}))
            tryVerify(function() { return source.width >= 48 && source.height >= 48 }, 1000,
                "package input must finish layout before pointer input")
            grabImage(harness.Window.window.contentItem).save(cfg.capture + ".before-input.png")
            mouseClick(source, source.width / 2, source.height / 2)
            tryVerify(function() { return source.activeFocus }, 1000,
                "center click must focus the real package input")
            source.selectAll()
            for (const letter of cfg.source) keyClick(letter)
            console.log("RECOVERY-INPUT " + JSON.stringify({text: source.text,
                expected: cfg.source, panelSource: panel.packageImportSource,
                activeFocus: source.activeFocus}))
            compare(source.text, cfg.source, "typed package path must reach the actual input")
            compare(panel.packageImportSource, cfg.source, "input must reach the panel model")
            const examine = matching(dialog.contentItem, function(item) {
                return item.text === "Examinar" && typeof item.clicked === "function"
            })
            verify(examine !== null, "actual Examinar button must be found")
            verify(examine.enabled, "actual Examinar button must be enabled after typing")
            mouseClick(examine)
            tryVerify(function() { return panel.packageImportPreview !== null
                && !panel.packageImportBusy }, 5000)
            compare(panel.packageImportPreview.themeId, cfg.themeId)
            compare(panel.packageImportPreview.alreadyInstalled, false)
            compare(panel.packageImportPreview.hasPreservedData, true)
            const confirm = findChild(panel, "packageImportOverwriteCheck")
            const install = findChild(panel, "packageImportApplyButton")
            verify(confirm !== null && confirm.visible && !confirm.checked)
            verify(install !== null && !install.enabled)
            for (const item of [source, examine, confirm, install]) {
                const point = item.mapToItem(harness, 0, 0)
                verify(point.x >= 0 && point.y >= 0
                    && point.x + item.width <= harness.width
                    && point.y + item.height <= harness.height,
                    "recovery control outside viewport: " + item.objectName)
            }
            wait(80)
            grabImage(harness.Window.window.contentItem).save(cfg.capture)
            mouseClick(confirm)
            tryVerify(function() { return panel.packageImportOverwrite && install.enabled })
            mouseClick(install)
            tryVerify(function() { return !panel.packageImportBusy
                && panel.packageImportNotice.indexOf("Pacote importado") >= 0 }, 5000)
            verify(!panel.packageImportNoticeIsError)
            compare(harness.errors.length, 0)
            console.log("INSTALLED-PACKAGE-RECOVERY " + cfg.themeId)
            dialog.close()
        }
    }
}
'''
harness_path = qml / "check_installed_package_recovery.qml"
harness_path.write_text(prefix + body)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="steamzero-theme-recovery-input-", dir="/tmp") as public_input:
    for compact in (False, True):
        name = "package-recovery-compact" if compact else "package-recovery-wide"
        profile = Path(temporary) / name
        profile.mkdir()
        with pytest.MonkeyPatch.context() as patch:
            dashboard = recovery.dashboard.__wrapped__(profile, patch)
            theme_id, theme_manifest, original = recovery._native_removal_target(dashboard)
            session = str(dashboard.editor_load(theme_id)["sessionId"])
            archive = Path(public_input) / ("recovery-compact.zip" if compact else "recovery-wide.zip")
            archive.write_bytes(dashboard.editor_export_zip(session))
            dashboard.editor_cancel(session)
            activation = dashboard.plan_theme_apply(theme_id)
            dashboard.apply_theme_preference(activation["planId"], activation["confirmToken"])
            activation = dashboard.plan_theme_apply("org.steamzero.default")
            switched = dashboard.apply_theme_preference(activation["planId"], activation["confirmToken"])
            dashboard.theme_catalog_uninstall(theme_id)
            preserved = paths.theme_preference_path().read_bytes()
            try:
                dashboard.rollback_theme(switched["operationId"])
            except SteamZeroError as exc:
                assert exc.code == "E-THEME-NOT-FOUND"
            else:
                raise AssertionError("missing target accepted before UI reimport")
            ready = queue.Queue()
            def serve():
                with StateStore(profile / "ui-state.db") as store:
                    store.migrate()
                    server = DesktopControlServer(
                        ExperienceCoordinator(Context(), (), store), "owned-recovery-token", dashboard
                    )
                    ready.put(server)
                    try:
                        server.serve_forever(poll_interval=0.02)
                    finally:
                        server.server_close()
            thread = threading.Thread(target=serve, daemon=True)
            thread.start()
            server = ready.get(timeout=5)
            config = qa_root / "build/ui-native-wheel-authoring.json"
            config.parent.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            capture = captures / (name + ".png")
            config.write_text(json.dumps({
                "apiUrl": f"http://127.0.0.1:{server.server_port}",
                "apiToken": "owned-recovery-token", "source": str(archive), "themeId": theme_id,
                "viewportWidth":840 if compact else 1280, "viewportHeight":900,
                "visualScale":1.5 if compact else 1, "compact":compact, "capture":str(capture)
            }))
            env = dict(os.environ)
            env.update(QT_QPA_PLATFORM="offscreen", QT_QUICK_BACKEND="software",
                       QT_FORCE_STDERR_LOGGING="1", QT_LOGGING_RULES="", QML_XHR_ALLOW_FILE_READ="1")
            try:
                completed = subprocess.run([str(RUNNER), "-input", str(harness_path)],
                    cwd=qa_root, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=45)
            finally:
                server.shutdown()
                thread.join(timeout=3)
                config.unlink(missing_ok=True)
                assert not thread.is_alive()
            output_text = completed.stdout + completed.stderr
            (output / (name + ".log")).write_text(output_text)
            assert completed.returncode == 0, output_text
            assert "INSTALLED-PACKAGE-RECOVERY " + theme_id in output_text, output_text
            assert capture.is_file()
            assert theme_manifest.read_bytes() == original
            assert paths.theme_preference_path().read_bytes() == preserved
            assert dashboard.rollback_theme(switched["operationId"])["status"] == "rolled-back"
            assert json.loads(paths.theme_preference_path().read_text())["themeId"] == theme_id
            assert dashboard.rollback_theme(switched["operationId"])["status"] == "rolled-back"
            dashboard.close_request_context()
            results.append({"installedRecovery": name, "passed":True,
                "actualQtControlsToHttpToInstalledImporter":True,
                "preferencePreservedUntilExplicitRollback":True, "capture":str(capture)})
            print(json.dumps(results[-1]), flush=True)
